Point claims toward pages, reports, and source-linked artifacts.

Do not send applications, messages, emails, or third-party actions from this site index.

answer_routes.label: About
answer_routes.title: Himanshu is the person behind Bionic Banker.
answer_routes.body: He is a computer engineer working in finance, building public proof around AML, AI agents, blockchain risk, observability, and technical education. Start with the About section, then open Projects for proof lanes.
followups: Where are the numbers and charts?

answer_routes.label: AML
answer_routes.title: The AML lane combines detection with explanation.
answer_routes.body: The AML Engine maps wallet behavior into risk signals. The Roaster turns those findings into plain-language narratives so a reviewer can understand what triggered the risk.
followups: Where are the numbers and charts?

answer_routes.label: Agents
answer_routes.source: Proof Tour, Agent Case Study, Learn
answer_routes.title: The agent work is about coordination and proof.
answer_routes.body: The site shows agent workflows as governed systems: roles, evidence, limits, heartbeat rows, and approval boundaries. Use Proof Tour for the shortest route.
followups: How do I learn the AI terms?

answer_routes.label: Reports
answer_routes.title: The report layer turns proof into numbers and charts.
answer_routes.body: Reports collects evidence density, benchmark bars, capability radar, and limitations. It is the best page when you want engineering-style proof instead of only a story.
followups: Is anything on the site live?

answer_routes.label: Learn
answer_routes.title: The learning layer explains the terms before the proof.
answer_routes.body: Use Learn when a phrase needs plain language: RAG, LLMs, VLMs, tool calling, RBAC, audit logs, observability, AML, Docker, and Kubernetes.
followups: Where are the numbers and charts?

answer_routes.label: AI Intelligence
answer_routes.source: AI Intelligence, Heartbeat JSON, Proof Tour
answer_routes.title: AI Intelligence shows visible signal rows.
answer_routes.body: This is where the site feels alive: market context, heartbeat snapshot rows, ticket rows, and research-only limits. It is not investment advice or trading performance.

answer_routes.label: Questions
answer_routes.title: The Questions page maps modern AI questions to proof.
answer_routes.body: Questions starts with what people ask about AI systems, then connects each question to a plain answer, a useful example, and a proof route.

answer_routes.label: Start here
answer_routes.title: Use the proof tour first, then choose your depth.
answer_routes.body: The shortest path is Proof Tour, then Reports if you want numbers, Projects if you want work samples, and Learn if a concept needs plain language.
followups: Is anything on the site live?
